story.titleZh: 2026年F1最佳赛事？巴西大奖赛混乱的点评
story.summaryZh: 2026年F1巴西大奖赛的混乱表现引发了众多思考，Scott Mitchell-Malm认为这既是对F1赛事活力的肯定，也是对赛事可能出现的平淡无奇的警告。
story.originalTitle: F1 2026's best race? Our verdict on Brazil chaos
detailZh: 2026年一级方程式最佳赛事？2027年F1的预览？反向发车赛事的模板还是对它们的警示？一场混乱的巴西大奖赛让我们有很多思考。
让我们来看看我们团队对这场比赛的看法...
一旦主要锦标赛早早决出胜负，总会有一种可怕的风险，那就是收官阶段变得非常平淡和缺乏活力，充斥着毫无悬念的比赛。
尤其是当领跑的冠军仍然有实力赢得剩余的比赛时。幸运的是，即使没有（车手）冠军在望，我们仍然有机会看到每场比赛都有强烈的叙事。而且，你总是可以期待Interlagos在赛季中带来一些特别的事情！
今天有什么好不高兴的呢？我记不起有哪场比赛像今天这样充满了精彩瞬间。
比赛开始时的领先权变化，利亚姆·劳森短暂地排在第二位，刘易斯·汉密尔顿荒谬的开局圈，马克斯·维斯塔潘持续而精彩的冲刺至第二位，乔治·罗素在维修区打转（这很少见！），基米·安东内利在领先时失控（然后又失去了领奖台，同样很少见！）……
唯一缺少的就是一场激烈的胜利争夺战。但即使这种失望也因诺里斯展现出的真正高水平的驾驶而得到了缓解，我希望很多人都能欣赏到这种质量。
如果/当一级方程式赛车在阿布扎比比赛时，我会数着圈数，因为我对这个比赛有着极其低落的期望，甚至包括卡塔尔，无论对那些比赛的任何更广泛的讨论。
所以如果赛季陷入低谷，我们总还有巴西...
本可以更好的学期末乐趣
这场比赛有很多值得欣赏的地方，包括其曲折和转折，这一切都得益于Interlagos的赛道布局、赛场的典型天气模式和氛围。一些惊人的超越动作，一些非常奇怪的事件，以及一些惊喜。
但那个并非弱势的杆位车手仍然赢得了比赛。我希望一场开始于小红牛和奥迪在排位赛的前四名、哈斯第六名，以及两名排名最靠后的车（阿斯顿·马丁和威廉姆斯）在前十名中的比赛，没有回到如此‘老一套’的大赢家格局——同时也非常享受维斯塔潘的史诗级进步。
虽然希望进步能带来一些更重要的意义，但想象一下，如果他仍然在与他的精神继承者安东内利争夺冠军的情况下展开这样的场景，即使是法拉利的混乱比赛仍然为车队赢得了一些积分。
总体评价：非常有趣，但遗憾的是没有结果。
这是反对反向排位的完美论据
马特已经找到了为什么对我来说，2026年巴西大奖赛是为什么添加反向排位格式会对F1造成灾难性影响的绝佳证据。
我看到了很多关于这场比赛实际上是一场反向发车实验的引用，维斯塔潘、刘易斯·汉密尔顿和查尔斯·勒克莱尔都站在发车区的错误一端。
观看他们恢复的过程很有趣，但也突显了反向发车会失败的两个原因。
第一个原因是，最终的结果实际上和标准发车区差不多，尤其是在像巴西这样的地方，你可以超车。速度更快的赛车不可避免地会通过。而且，如果你有什么的话，你可能会削弱领先战，因为一辆早些时候穿过车流的车可以简单地拉开距离，而他们的最接近的竞争对手的表现则被后面的慢车所破坏。
第二个问题是新鲜感。我喜欢这场比赛。观看法拉利和维斯塔潘等人在比赛中追回领先，而劳森和尼科·胡肯伯格在前面扮演了明星角色，真是太棒了。
但是你能想象每一场比赛都是这样吗？这种新奇的元素会很快消失，你最初看到它的特殊之处也会完全消失，被彻底拆解吗？
所以，请F1保持这种比赛像它现在这样成为罕见的佳肴，而不是未来的模板。
今年最好的比赛？不是。今年最激动人心的比赛？是的。
多变的天气总是增加了比赛的激情；也许我们应该记住伯尼·埃克尔斯顿关于随机喷水系统的建议……
我在这些多变的条件下站在维修区墙上，所以我可以向你保证，正确阅读天气变化并不容易。
你需要从你的车手那里获得一流的信息，并准备好应对任何情况。你需要准备好在完成第二阶段后立即进站。晚一点，由于速度非常快，晚些时候进站的决定可能会非常容易导致你的车撞上护栏。
诺里斯正在证明他在这种条件下非常出色，维斯塔潘也是如此，还有其他几位车手，但在从干胎胎面切换到湿地胎面然后再回到干胎胎面时保持冷静，同时不犯任何错误，领导比赛并非易事。
作为领头的赛车，意味着你要为其他人树立榜样，因此保持抓地力水平至关重要。
除此之外，一些通常的领跑者从后面起步，又给比赛增添了另一层悬念；也许一些反向排位的比赛不应该被轻易否定...
无论如何，最令人兴奋的部分是看到麦克拉伦、小红牛和法拉利已经明显缩小了与梅赛德斯的差距。在赛季初期的统治性表现之后，无疑帮助安东内利赢得了车手冠军，梅赛德斯赢得了车队冠军，看到前方的竞争如此接近真是太棒了。
我不确定这周末法拉利发生了什么，但正如我们看到的，所有车队从周末到周末都有起伏 - 持续地从赛车中获取最佳表现似乎并不容易！
随着我们进入2026年的黄昏赛事，一切预示着下个赛季的顺利。希望我们能在第一场比赛中看到更加激烈的竞争，整个赛季都保持紧密的战斗；我迫不及待了。
detailEn: Formula 1 2026's best race? A preview for F1 2027? A template for reverse grid races or a cautionary warning against them? A chaotic Brazilian Grand Prix gave us plenty to think about.
Here's what our team thought about the race...
There's always a terrible risk that the run-in ends up being really flat and low energy, with a collection of dead-rubber races, once the main championship is decided early.

That's especially the case when the runaway champion is still a decent contender to win the remaining races. Fortunately, we have a good stab at seeing strong race-by-race narratives even without a (drivers') title on the line. And you can always count on Interlagos to throw up something special in a season!
What was there not to enjoy about today? I can't remember a race that had so much packed into it.

A change of lead at the start, Liam Lawson briefly running second, Lewis Hamilton's absurd opening lap, Max Verstappen's much more sustained and spectacular charge to second, George Russell spinning in the pitlane (that's rare!), Kimi Antonelli chucking it off while leading (then again to lose out on a podium, almost as rare!)...

The only thing it was missing was a close fight for victory. But even that disappointment is tempered by the knowledge that Norris produced a really classy drive that I hope a lot of people can appreciate the quality of.
I'll be counting down the laps if/when F1 races in Abu Dhabi, for I have immensely low hopes for that race, and even Qatar, regardless of any wider debate over those races.
So if the season nosedives into an anti-climax, we'll always have Brazil...
End-of-term fun that could've been even better

There was a lot to enjoy about that race and its twists and turns, all helped by the Interlagos layout, the venue's typical weather pattern and atmosphere. Some amazing overtaking moves, some very weird incidents and quite a few surprises.

But the not-an-underdog polesitter still won it. And I wish a race that started with a Racing Bulls and an Audi in the top four on the grid, a Haas sixth and two of the worst cars on the grid (an Aston Martin and a Williams) in the top 10 hadn't reverted to quite such a 'usual suspects' sweep of the major positions - while also really enjoying Verstappen's epic progress in particular.

Wish that progress had counted for something a bit more significant, though. Imagine that scenario unfolding with him still in a title fight with, say, his spiritual successor Antonelli. Even Ferrari's chaotic mess of a race still earned it a few points.
Overall verdict: very entertaining, sadly inconsequential.
The perfect argument against reverse grids
Matt has hit upon why, for me, the 2026 Brazilian Grand Prix is great evidence of why adding a reverse grid format would be terrible for F1.
I saw plenty of references to this race essentially being a reverse grid experiment with Verstappen, Lewis Hamilton and Charles Leclerc all at the wrong end of the grid.
While it was entertaining to watch them recover, it highlighted why reverse grids would fail for two reasons.

Number one is that you actually end up with a similar result anyway to a standard grid, especially at somewhere like Brazil, where you can overtake. The faster cars are inevitably going to come through. And if anything you can end up diluting the lead battle, because one car that gets through the traffic earlier, can simply pull away while their closest rival performance is marred behind slower cars.

And the second problem is the novelty factor. I loved this race. Watching the likes of the Ferraris and Verstappen battle back through, while the likes of Lawson and Nico Hulkenberg got starring roles at the front, was brilliant.
But can you imagine that every race? How quickly that novelty factor would wear off and you lose the very reason it's so special to see it in the first place, be completely dismantled?
So please F1. Keep this kind of race the rare treat that it is, not the template for the future.
Hope for 2027!
Best race of the year? No. Most exciting race of the year? Yes.
Changeable weather always adds to the excitement; perhaps we should remember Bernie Ecclestone’s suggestion of a random sprinkler system……
I have been there on the pitwall in these changeable conditions, so I can assure you reading the weather changes correctly is not easy.

You need first-rate information from your driver and to be ready for anything. You need to be ready to pit as you finish sector two really. Any later, and as it’s so fast, a late call into the pits can very easily end up with your car in the barrier.

Norris is proving that he is brilliant in these conditions, as is Verstappen, plus a few others, but keeping cool when going from inters to slicks and then back to inters without making any mistakes whilst leading is no easy task.
Being the lead car means you are setting the example for the others, so driving within the grip level is critical.
To add to that, having a few of the usual frontrunners starting at the back just gave it another twist; again, perhaps a few reverse grid races shouldn’t be dismissed out of hand...

Anyway, the best part of it is seeing that McLaren, Red Bull and Ferrari have definitely closed the gap to Mercedes. After such a dominant start to the season, which without doubt helped Antonelli win the drivers' championship and Mercedes win the constructors' championship, it’s great to see much closer competition at the front.

I'm not sure what happened to Ferrari this weekend, but as we see with all the teams from weekend to weekend, they have their ups and downs - consistently getting the best from the car doesn’t seem to be easy!

As we head into the twilight races of 2026, it all bodes well for next season. Hopefully, we will see much closer competition from the first race and close battling right through the season; I can’t wait.
keyPointsZh: 赛事中出现了多次领先变化和意外事件。
尽管没有冠军头衔的争夺，但赛事仍然充满悬念和精彩瞬间。
keyPointsEn: The race featured multiple lead changes and unexpected events.
Even without a championship title at stake, the race was filled with suspense and exciting moments.

relatedItems.titleZh: 安东内利与梅赛德斯包揽卡塔尔大奖赛练习赛
relatedItems.summaryZh: 基米·安东内利在卡塔尔大奖赛FP3练习赛中连续三次夺冠，梅赛德斯竞争对手似乎在争夺最佳非梅赛德斯车队，红牛在第三次练习赛中取得第三名。
relatedItems.originalTitle: Antonelli and Mercedes sweep Qatar GP practice
detailZh: 基米·安东内利在卡塔尔大奖赛FP3练习赛中连续三次夺冠，梅赛德斯竞争对手似乎在争夺最佳非梅赛德斯车队，红牛在第三次练习赛中取得第三名。
在排位赛前的20分钟内，练习赛中的圈数非常少。似乎很少有车手能在他们的第一次排位赛中取得更好的成绩。
安东内利的队友乔治·拉塞尔在第二阶段的表现中保持了领先，尽管他在著名的14号弯角发生了一次打滑，那里的地板损坏总是令人担忧，这使安东内利得以缩小到落后0.017秒。
但在第三次尝试中，安东内利全速前进，逆转了排名，领先拉塞尔0.249秒，这个成绩无人能及。
梅赛德斯的车手在任何时刻都落后了半秒左右，红牛车队的马克斯·维斯塔潘在练习结束时排名第三，落后安东内利0.510秒。
维斯塔潘的队友伊萨克·哈德贾排名第四，领先略有提升的法拉利车手查尔斯·勒克莱尔，勒克莱尔在周五的比赛中表现不佳，非常悲观。
勒克莱尔的队友刘易斯·汉密尔顿排名第九，抱怨赛车转向不足，并要求增加前翼角度以避免提前进站。
奥斯卡·皮亚斯蒂在最后一次性能测试跑之前排名第三，但在第六和第七位时被麦凯轮车队的兰多·诺里斯超越，最终排名下降。
皮亚斯特里是众多抱怨转向不足的车手之一。
小红牛在周五表现得非常乐观，并在FP3练习中领跑中游，Arvid Lindblad排名第八，劳森排名第十，领先其中游对手两十分。
阿尔派恩落后小红牛很多，小红牛在车队积分榜上领先Enstone车队27分，争夺第五名。加斯利在FP3练习中排名第14，队友科拉平托排名第16。
科拉平托在最后阶段幸运地避开了高速移动的斯特罗尔，这一事件将在练习结束后进行调查。
在劳森和加斯利之间是奥迪和哈斯车队的奥利·贝尔曼，他的队友拉斐尔·卡马拉排名第15。
费尔南多·阿隆索超越了两辆威廉姆斯赛车，为阿斯顿·马丁赢得了第17名。
凯迪拉克车队以瓦尔特里·博塔斯领先近0.7秒的成绩，排在最后一名塞尔吉奥·佩雷斯之前。
第17名 费尔南多·阿隆索（阿斯顿·马丁）+2.696秒
detailEn: Kimi Antonelli completed a hat-trick of practice sweeps in FP3 for the Qatar Grand Prix, as Mercedes' rivals appear to be fighting for the best of the rest with Red Bull taking that honour in third practice.
Very few laps were turned in the first 20 minutes or so, before qualifying runs. It appeared that few drivers could improve on their first qualifying efforts.

Antonelli's team-mate George Russell set the early pace and maintained that lead after the second performance runs despite a wide moment through the notorious Turn 14 - where floor damage is always a worry - and that allowed Antonelli to close in to just 0.017s behind.
But on the third attempts, Antonelli turned on the afterburners to flip the order and lead Russell by 0.249s, which would not be beaten.
Mercedes' challengers were regularly around half a second down at any given point, with Red Bull's Max Verstappen taking third at the end of the session, 0.510s adrift of Antonelli.
Verstappen's team-mate Isack Hadjar took fourth ahead of the slightly improved Ferrari of Charles Leclerc, who was very pessimistic after Friday's running.
Leclerc's team-mate Lewis Hamilton was down in ninth, complaining that the car was not turning in sufficiently and asking for more front wing angle to avoid understeer.
Oscar Piastri had been third before the last performance run attempt, but was jumped by McLaren team-mate Lando Norris as they ran sixth and seventh, shuffled down the order by the end.
Piastri was another of the many drivers complaining of understeer.
Racing Bulls was extremely bullish on Friday and did head the midfield in FP3 with Arvid Lindblad in eighth and Liam Lawson in 10th, two tenths clear of its midfield rivals.

Alpine was well behind Racing Bulls, which is 27 points ahead of the Enstone team in the chase for fifth in the constructors' standings. Pierre Gasly finished 14th and team-mate Franco Colapinto 16th in FP3.
Colapinto was lucky to avoid a slow-moving Lance Stroll at high speed in the closing stages and that incident will be investigated after the session.
Between Lawson and Gasly were the Audis and Haas driver Ollie Bearman, whose team-mate Rafael Camara finished 15th.
Fernando Alonso cleared both Williams to take 17th for Aston Martin.
Cadillac anchored the order with Valtteri Bottas nearly 0.7s ahead of last-place Sergio Perez.
17 Fernando Alonso (Aston Martin) +2.696s
keyPointsZh: 梅赛德斯竞争对手在练习赛中落后梅赛德斯约半秒。
keyPointsEn: Mercedes' challengers were around half a second behind at any given point.

relatedItems.titleZh: 韩泰启动F1轮胎测试并接触车队，准备竞标2029年供应合同
relatedItems.summaryZh: 韩泰已启动F1轮胎测试计划并与车队展开谈判，准备竞标从2029年起成为F1官方轮胎供应商。F1当前与倍耐力的合同持续到2028年底。
relatedItems.originalTitle: Hankook emerges with serious F1 tyre supply push
relatedItems.summaryEn: Hankook has begun a Formula 1 tyre testing programme and opened talks with teams as it prepares to bid to become the official F1 tyre supplier from 2029. F1's current contract with Pirelli runs until the end of 2028.
detailZh: 据The Race了解，韩泰已启动一项F1轮胎测试计划，并与车队展开谈判，为竞标从2029年起成为大奖赛官方供应商做准备。
F1目前与倍耐力的合同持续到2028年底。此前，这家意大利公司击败普利司通的竞争性报价，赢得了F1最近一次招标合同，覆盖2025至2027年。
今年6月，在国际汽联行使选择权后，其合同又延长了一个赛季。
然而，从2029年起，国际汽联将启动新的招标程序，届时似乎将出现新的竞争，以争夺F1官方供应商资格。
据了解，倍耐力希望先等待看到招标细节，然后再决定是否参与竞标，以延长其自2011年以来的当前合约期，而普利司通长期以来一直在评估重返F1的可能性，其代表已出席过多场比赛。
然而，现在有消息显示，韩泰也准备加入竞争，并且一直在暗中加大自身的努力。
该公司的代表被发现出现在最近的拉斯维加斯大奖赛上，据了解，这是他们继9月前往马德里之后，今年第二次造访F1比赛。
据The Race了解，韩泰利用这些行程会见了大多数车队，并与老板、首席执行官和其他高级管理人员讨论了计划。
然而，前往各地观看比赛——其中还包括2025年在中国、日本和新加坡举行的赛事——只是其为2029年做准备的努力的一方面。
据了解，韩泰已在公司内部组建了一支44人的专项工作组，为进入F1做准备。
除了投入研发能力和模拟器运行之外，该公司今年还使用一辆改装的F2同级测试车完成了两次F1轮胎开发测试，以评估潜在的轮胎结构以及不同配方。
第三次测试已安排用于研发其雨地轮胎，该公司希望这也能帮助其开发出一款具有更窄水雾羽流的轮胎，以减少湿地条件下造成的能见度问题。
韩泰也在努力进行生产和制造规划，以满足任何轮胎招标合同下供应F1、F2和F3轮胎所需。
韩泰对国际汽联的赛事当然并不陌生，这家韩国公司已经是世界拉力锦标赛的官方轮胎供应商，并且刚刚结束了对电动方程式锦标赛的供应，而普利司通将在即将到来的赛季接替。今年早些时候，韩泰还被指定为该管理机构的全球合作伙伴。
2029年之后的新F1轮胎招标期几乎肯定会涵盖向下一个规则时代的过渡，F1正着眼于更轻、更灵活的新赛车，以配合从2030年开始改用V8动力单元。
这些计划还将包括一种新的轮胎设计，该设计将比目前的18英寸设计略微减小车轮尺寸。
detailEn: Hankook has begun a Formula 1 tyre testing programme and opened talks with teams as it prepares to bid on becoming grand prix racing’s official supplier from 2029, The Race has learned.

F1’s current contract with Pirelli runs until the end of 2028, after the Italian company won F1’s most recent tender deal, which covered the period from 2025-2027, against a rival bid from Bridgestone.
Its contract was extended by a further season in June this year after an option was taken up by the FIA.
From 2029, however, a new tender process is set to be launched by the FIA and there looks set to be fresh competition to secure the right to be the official F1 supplier.

It is understood that Pirelli wants to wait to see details of the tender before deciding if it enters the fray to extend its current spell which stretches back to 2011, while Bridgestone has long evaluated an F1 return with representatives having attended races.
However, it has now emerged that Hankook is ready to throw its hat into the ring too and has been secretly ramping up its own efforts.
Representatives of the company were spotted at the recent Las Vegas Grand Prix, which was understood to have been their second visit to an F1 race this year following a trip to Madrid in September.
The Race understands that Hankook has used these trips to meet a majority of teams and discuss plans with bosses, CEOs and other senior executives.
The trips to races, which also included visits to events in China, Japan and Singapore in 2025, are only one side of its efforts to get ready for 2029, however.
It is understood that Hankook has already committed a 44-person task force within the company to prepare for an F1 entry.

Beyond committing research and development capability plus simulator running, it has this year completed two development tests for F1 rubber using a modified F2-equivalent-mule car to evaluate potential construction as well as different compounds.

A third test has been scheduled to work on its wet-weather rubber, which it hopes can also help it develop a tyre that features a narrower spray plume to reduce visibility problems caused in wet conditions.
Hankook is also working hard on production and manufacturing planning that would be required to supply F1, F2 and F3 tyres that would come under the umbrella of any tyre tender contract.

Hankook is certainly no stranger to FIA competition, with the South Korean company already the official tyre supplier to the World Rally Championship and has just ended its supply to Formula E where Bridgestone is taking over for the upcoming season. Earlier this year Hankook was also named as a global partner of the governing body.

The period of the new F1 tyre tender beyond 2029 will almost certainly cover the transition to the next rules era, with F1 setting sights on new lighter and nimbler cars to coincide with the switch to V8 power units from 2030.
The plans are also set to include a new tyre design, which is set to reduce wheel size slightly from the current 18-inch design.

国际汽联将从2029年起启动新的招标程序，届时预计将出现新的竞争以争夺F1官方供应商资格。
